Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1) Functional Requirements:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Users can send and receive messages in 1:1 and group chats (ordered,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: persistent history).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Messages support rich media (images, videos, files).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Users receive real-time in-app and push notifications for new

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: messages.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Users can delete their own messages, reflecting across all devices.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: ---- Out of scope ------

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - End-to-end encryption.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Search functionality within chats.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Voice and video calling.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Complex user presence (e.g., "last seen at").

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2) Scale of the System:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - 1B+ Monthly Active Users (MAU).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - 100K+ concurrent messages/sec across large chat rooms.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3) Non Functional Requirements (SPARCS):

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Scalability: Support 1B+ MAU, 100K+ concurrent messages/sec.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Performance: P95 end-to-end message delivery latency < 200ms.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Availability: CAP-Aware Messaging Guarantees (prioritize availability,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: enforce strong per-chat ordering).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Reliability: Message Durability (persist before ack; zero acknowledged

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: message loss).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Consistency: Consistent Multi-Device state (P95 sync < 300ms, <1%

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: read/notification inconsistency).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: ------- Out of Scope --------

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Advanced spam detection and automated content moderation.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Complex analytics pipelines and administrative dashboards.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4) BOE Calculations:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Load / Traffic (QPS)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Read QPS: 5*(500M DAU)/ (10^5) => 25k QPS

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Write QPS: 5k QPS

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Peak QPS: (X3) ≈ 90k QPS

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Storage

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Daily storage = 500M writes × 1 KB average request => 500 GB

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Yearly storage = 500 GB × 365 => 182.5 TB

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Total storage = 182.5 TB × 5 => 912.5 TB

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > replication ≈ 912.5 TB × 3 => 2.73 PB

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Bandwidth

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Ingress = 5,000 write QPS × 1 KB average write => 5 MB/s

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Egress = 25,000 read QPS × 1 KB average read => 25 MB/s

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Cache

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > 2.5B daily read requests × 1 KB × 0.20 = 500GB

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: -- We could add a factor of 100 for all given we are allowing media files

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: which are huge in size. But again media is mostly stored in S3.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Design Slack

text.font-family: Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Design

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Potential Deep Dives

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: High Level Design

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1) Message Ordering Consistency

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - The Problem: Concurrent messages from different devices can arrive out

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: of order, confusing chat flow.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Option 1 (Client Timestamps): Unreliable due to clock drift and potential

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: manipulation.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Option 2 (DB Sequence Counter): Chat server assigns a strict sequence

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: number per chat. Good for medium scale, but atomic increments become a

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: bottleneck at high scale.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Option 3 (Kafka-Based Ingestion - Recommended): Route messages

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: through Kafka, partitioning by chat_id. Kafka enforces strict serial

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: ordering per partition before writing to the DB.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Hot Shard Alert: "Celebrity" or "All-Hands" chats can overwhelm a single

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Kafka partition. Mitigate with dedicated high-throughput topics or hybrid

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: fan-out models.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2) Scaling WebSocket Infrastructure

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Bottleneck 1: Session Lookup & Fan-out: Querying a DB for active

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: sessions on every message is too slow.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Solution: Shift to Pub/Sub (Redis/Kafka). WS servers subscribe only

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: to chat_channel:<chat_id> for their currently connected users.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Bottleneck 2: User Churn (Moving between WS servers): Rapid

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: disconnects/reconnects leave stale subscriptions and cause duplicate fan-

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: outs.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Solution (Leased Ownership): WS servers set a Redis TTL lease (e.g.,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: user:A = ws-1 EX 10). Only the server holding the valid lease subscribes to

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: that user's chat channels. If the user drops, the lease expires, stopping

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: wasted fan-out.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Bottleneck 3: DB Storage Pressure: Massive write load for group chat

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: fan-outs and read load for reconnections.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Solution: Horizontally partition messages (by chat_id) and inbox (by

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: user_id). Use Redis/Memcached to cache hot metadata (chat members,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: active sessions, recent messages) to protect the DB.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3) Multi-Device Management

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - The Problem: Users have multiple active devices (phone, laptop). They

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: need real-time delivery on all active screens, reliable replay on disconnected

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: ones, and no duplicate messages.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - The Flow:

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Devices register individually in device_sessions (e.g., User:A:Phone ->

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: ws-1, User:A:Laptop -> ws-2).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > WS servers fan-out messages to all active sessions for that user.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > If a specific device is offline, the message goes to the inbox keyed to

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: that exact device_id.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Deduplication (The Silent Killer): A user might get a message via WS on

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: their phone, but via Inbox Replay on their laptop.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: > Solution: Every message has a unique message_id. Clients maintain a

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: local cache of recent IDs. If a client receives a message it already has, it

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: silently drops it. Never rely purely on backend deduplication.

text.font-family: Lilita One, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Deep Dive

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Requirement Meeting

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1) Messaging

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Client Send: User sends message; client emits send_message via WebSocket

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: (includes chat_id, content, optional parent_message_id).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Gateway: Authenticates session, checks rate limits, and routes to correct -

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Chat Server using consistent hashing.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Validation & Storage: Chat Server verifies user in chat_members. Generates

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: message_id, timestamp, and saves to messages table.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Fan-out: Chat Server finds active DeviceSessions and broadcasts

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: new_message to online participants.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2) Rich Media Support (Images/Video)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Decoupled Upload: Media is never sent over WebSockets to prevent blocking

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: text messages.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Object Storage: Client uploads file directly to an Object Store (e.g., S3) via

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: HTTP REST API.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Message Attachment: Client receives a media_url from S3 and attaches it

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: to the standard WebSocket payload.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3) Real-Time Notifications (Online vs. Offline)

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Presence Check: Chat Server checks device_sessions to split participants

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: into Online and Offline buckets.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Online Routing: Broadcasts instantly via WebSocket.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Offline Routing: Writes message to inbox table and triggers FCM/APNs push

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: notification.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Reconnect Replay: When an offline user opens the app, Gateway connects

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: WS, fetches missed messages from inbox, and marks delivered_at.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Cleanup: Background cron job purges undelivered inbox messages after 30

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: days.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4) Message Deletion

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Client Request: Client emits delete_message WebSocket event with

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: message_id.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Authorization: Chat Server verifies the requester is the original sender_id.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Soft Delete: Server updates messages table, setting is_deleted = true

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: (never hard delete).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Online Sync: Server broadcasts message_deleted event to instantly update

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: active UIs.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Offline Sync (Delivered): Queues deletion event in inbox for devices that

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: already received the text.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Offline Sync (Undelivered): Silently removes the inbox row. Recipient never

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: sees the original message or the deletion event.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Key Concepts on the go

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: This problem covers in a holistic way some of the key realtime chat application features.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 1) Message Deletion & Storage

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Never delete a message from the database just because it was delivered

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: to the user's phone.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Keep messages saved for chat history and syncing across devices.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Only delete a message if the sender explicitly deletes it, or if there is an

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: automatic rule (like auto-deleting after 30 days).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 2) Threaded Conversations

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - What are threads? Threads let users reply directly to a specific

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: message, creating a focused, nested mini-chat inside the main conversation

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: (like Slack).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - How to build it: Instead of creating a complex new system for threads,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: just add an optional parent_message_id to standard messages.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - This simple change makes it easy to load thread replies and send

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: notifications only to the people chatting in that specific thread.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 3) Syncing Multiple Devices

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Users are often logged into their phone and laptop at the same time.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - The system must ensure "read" statuses sync perfectly across all

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: screens and stop duplicate push notifications from buzzing every device in

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: the room.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 4) "Client" vs. "DeviceSession"

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - A Client is just the software platform (e.g., the iOS app or a Web

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: browser).

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - A DeviceSession is the actual, active connection between that device

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: and the server.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Why track sessions? It tells the server exactly how to route messages

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: (e.g., via WebSocket to an open laptop, or via Push Notification to a

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: locked phone), accurately tracks granular online/offline presence, and

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - enforces the cross-device consistency mentioned above.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 5) Smart Read Receipts

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - Don't mark a message as "read" just because it reached the device.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - The app should only send a read_receipt event to the server when the

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: message actually appears on the user's screen.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - The server then updates the database and updates the sender's screen

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: with "Read" or double-ticks.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 6) Direct Media Downloads: The backend only stores a media_url. Clients

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: download heavy files directly from object storage (like S3) to prevent

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: backend bottlenecking and save bandwidth.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 7) Online vs. Offline Presence: "Online" strictly means an active WebSocket

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: connection (instant delivery). "Offline" means no active connection

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: (triggers push notifications). This state is tracked via a DeviceSession

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: table.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 8) Push ≠ Delivery: Push notifications just wake the device using

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: metadata. True delivery only occurs when the user opens the app,

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: reconnects to WebSockets, and pulls the actual message payload from the

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: backend.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 9) 30-Day Offline Rule: To save space, undelivered queue records expire

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: after 30 days. The original message stays safe in the main database, but

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: returning users must manually fetch it via chat history APIs instead of

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: auto-receiving it.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 10) Clean Message Deletion: No ugly "message deleted" placeholders. The

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: backend soft-deletes the record (is_deleted = true), but the frontend

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: instantly performs a hard visual wipe for online users and hides it from

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: offline users' history entirely.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: 11) Database Trade-offs: Relational databases (MySQL + Vitess) offer

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: strong consistency and easy joins but are harder to scale. NoSQL

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: (DynamoDB) scales massively with low latency but sacrifices flexible

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: queries and introduces eventual consistency. Always debate the trade-offs

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: rather than just naming a tech stack.
